stemMd: A clinic records appointments and missed appointments: North 80 and 8; South 60 and 9; East 100 and 10. Which clinic has the highest missed-appointment rate?

options.label: B
options.textMd: North and East tie for the highest rate.

options.label: E
options.textMd: All three have the same rate.

explanationMd: Compare proportions, not raw missed counts. North has 8/80 = 10%, South 9/60 = 15%, and East 10/100 = 10%. South has the largest rate even though East has the largest number of missed appointments.

distractorRationale.d: Its rate is 8/80 = 10%, below South’s rate.
distractorRationale.c: Its rate is 10/100 = 10%, despite the largest missed count.
distractorRationale.b: They tie at 10%, but South is higher at 15%.
distractorRationale.e: The South proportion differs from the other two.
